q: Itô's formula for a stochastic process dXt = b(Xt)dt + σ(Xt)dWt and smooth function f gives:
opts: df(Xt) = (Lf)(Xt)dt where L is the generator
Both B and C are correct
exp: Itô's formula: df(Xt) = f'(Xt)b dt + f'(Xt)σ dWt + (1/2)f''(Xt)σ² dt. The extra (1/2)f''σ² dt term (Itô correction) arises from the quadratic variation ⟨dWt,dWt⟩=dt. The generator of the diffusion is Lf = bf' + (σ²/2)f''.
